title: E-mail outbox row
caption: `platform.email_outbox.status`. Secret data (links with tokens) is encrypted and erased at a final status (`secrets_purged_at`).

states.label: pending
states.detail: Queued in the caller's transaction; job email.send after commit.

states.label: failed
states.detail: 5 attempts used (30 s, 60 s, 120 s, 240 s backoff: about 7.5 min of SMTP outage) or unrecoverable (unknown template, bad variables or recipient, undecryptable secret). Never retried by the sweep.

states.label: canceled (CHECK only)
states.detail: Allowed by the CHECK; no code writes it.

transitions.label: email.sweep (every minute) re-enqueues rows older than 2 min whose job is missing or finished
email.sweep re-enqueues rows unchanged for 10 min (worker stopped mid-send)
